summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on debugging and fixing issues within the mall dashboard analytics. Initially, the dashboard was found to only display 'Total' data in the zone section, losing facility-specific grouping. It was noted that previous changes had broken much of the functionality.

Later, it was determined that two separate API endpoints were required: one for total metrics and another specifically for facility-based zones. The fix involved ensuring both sets of data could populate their respective blocks correctly, allowing all elements to function as intended.
decisions: The mall dashboard requires separate queries/endpoints for total metrics and facility-specific zone data.
action_items: A hotfix will be deployed on Monday morning to finalize the fixes.
